scc-10:share-vs-split record — the five storage-condition checks ran against the LANDED shared artifact (FunctionBodySkeleton + FunctionFlowGraph on one memoized FunctionFlowGraphStore bundle) and ALL FIVE PASS: checks 1-3 (structural detach: arena-free Send+Sync+'static NoTypeExpr skeleton/graph; build-time no-type-lowering; query-independent once-per-content-version identity) via flow_graph_is_arena_free_send_sync_static + flow_graph_build_is_deterministic_over_one_skeleton + skeleton_build_is_deterministic_per_content_version; check 4 against the production store via cache_runtime::flow_slice_node_tests::two_demands_one_function_flow_graph_build (build_count == 1 across two demands); check 5 end-to-end through the projector via component_meta_flow_return_admission_tests::return_type_member_demand_loads_only_the_walked_member (side.ts parse count 0, zero dispatch keys naming it). Recorded outcome per SCC-10: the shared implementation is SHARE-ELIGIBLE-AND-EVIDENCED — a shared artifact passing all five conditions is equally conforming; this records evidence, not a sharing preference.

debt:R2-UNAPPLIED-WRITE-EFFECT-SOURCE-ORDER — recon-confirmed over-degradation, fail-closed only (no wrong answer ever publishes): `function f(x: string | number) { return { b: x, a: (x = "s") }; }` degrades a correct `string | number` to UnappliedWriteEffect / ReturnOnly because the evaluator seeds the degradation for ANY whole-slot write into a value-selected/parameter slot without applying write effects. Durable owner: the narrowing / value-inference work on this same graph (U6.NARROW_SUBSTITUTION / U6.VALUE_INFERENCE own actual write-effect application; sound suppression needs evaluation-order reasoning across function boundaries). Resolution gate: no later than the U6 lane close — the U6 lane may not close with this entry open. Acceptance test (owed with the owning work): flow_return_source_order_object_read_before_write_publishes_clean — `{ b: x, a: (x = "s") }` publishes `{ b: string | number; a: string }` CLEAN + warm-admissible, WITH the deferred-read negative `{ b: () => x, a: (x = "s") }` still observing the write (`b: () => string`). The proposed span-comparison suppression (drop the degradation when every read span precedes the write span) is REJECTED AS UNSOUND: the deferred closure read observes the write despite preceding it in source (recon-executed against the pinned oracle tsgo `7.0.0-dev.20260526.1`).

debt:CONDITIONAL-VAR-BRANCH-JOIN — recon-confirmed over-degradation, fail-closed only (no wrong answer ever publishes): `function f(flag: boolean) { if (flag) var x: any = 1; else var x: any = "s"; return x; }` and `function f(flag: boolean) { if (flag) { var y: number | undefined = 1; } return y; }` degrade a usable value to ConditionalVarDefinition / ReturnOnly because the FUNCTION-scoped `var` layer survives the `if`-arm restore (as it must — `var` hoists), while nothing folds the arms: the surviving reaching definition is the last-evaluated arm's rather than the join over every arm and the never-assigned path. Durable owner: the narrowing work on this same graph (U6.NARROW_* own the join algebra, built on the shared FlowFrame lattice over the ONE FunctionFlowGraph's narrowing-predicate edge class — never a second flow structure; a merge algebra over the evaluator's `locals` / `var_locals` maps IS that second structure and is REJECTED AS OUT OF CONTRACT). Resolution gate: no later than the U6 lane close — the U6 lane may not close with this entry open. Acceptance tests (owed with the owning work): branchVar — `if (flag) var x: any = 1; else var x: any = "s"; return x` publishes `any` CLEAN + warm-admissible; branchVarUndef — `if (flag) { var y: number | undefined = 1; } return y` publishes `number | undefined` CLEAN + warm-admissible. Accepted cost until then: `if (flag) { var w = 1 } return w` returned a coincidentally-correct warm `number` and is now degraded — tsc REJECTS that program (TS2454, used before being assigned), so fail-closed is the correct trade.

debt:TYPE-SPACE-OWNER-PROBE-CARRIER-SETTLEMENT — DEFER-RATIFIED by the architecture authority (codex D2 ruling, `.feedback/orchestration/u6-d2-defer-out.txt`); RATIFIED and does NOT block U6.FLOW_RETURN_SUBSTRATE landing. The documented “owner scope answers nothing ⇒ evaluate unchanged” escape hatch is structurally dead for TYPE space: the probe lowers to a `BareRef` carrier rather than `Opaque`, so `owner_scope_answers_name` (crates/verter_session/src/project_semantic_dispatch/flow_return.rs) returns `true` even for a name owner scope does not bind. RULED: a `BareRef` is an UNRESOLVED CARRIER, not positive proof that owner scope answers the name — the probe must settle through the shared head-resolution authority and distinguish resolved / genuine miss / degraded uncertainty. Durable owner: U6.VALUE_INFERENCE. Resolution gate: same — no later than that block's landing, necessarily before the U6 lane close. Acceptance test (owed with the owning work): flow_return_unanswered_type_space_owner_probe_preserves_unresolved_carrier — owner-absent class/enum names preserve the UNCHANGED unresolved carrier, while a real owner-scope collision still fails closed and never substitutes or warm-publishes a wrong value. Leaving it unchanged would contradict the documented escape-hatch contract.

debt:RESIDUAL-NON-CALL-ANY-FABRICATION — DEFER with a recorded ledger entry, fail-closed direction not yet reached. The leaf gate (`leaf_answer_is_fabricated_at_a_call_position`, crates/verter_session/src/flow_slice_content.rs) refuses a leaf answer that embeds `any` only when the expression's value COMPOSES over a call with no structural arm. A residual set of NON-CALL forms still answers the shared shallow pass's `_ => Ok(Primitive(Any))` fallback and publishes it CLEAN and WARM: `JSXElement` / `JSXFragment`, a bare `Super`, `MetaProperty`, `ImportExpression` (`import("m")`), `ClassExpression`, an OPTIONAL MEMBER READ over a non-call base (`maybeObj?.b`, checker `string | undefined`), and `await x` over a NON-call operand. Ruled disposition: ADOPT-NOW for the call-composing half (`f()["q"]`, `f?.()?.q`, `fs() + "x"`, `z = fs()`, an array element at a call position, a non-structural object member at a call position — all now positional markers); DEFER for the residual non-call half, because telling a FABRICATED bare `any` from an AUTHORED one is a per-form modelling question owned downstream, not a gate widening. NOTE (measured, correcting the original justification): the tree already refuses the authored one whenever its OPERAND is a frame binding — `function f() { const raw: unknown = 1; return { label: "x", made: raw as any } }` publishes the typed positional marker with `UnmodeledPosition` and zero candidates, because the root-identifier gate fires on `raw` before the leaf's `any` answer is read. It is only the FREE-operand spelling (`declare const outerRaw: unknown; outerRaw as any`) that still publishes `Primitive(Any)` clean and warm. So the deferral is not "we cannot refuse `any` without refusing the authored one" — it is that the two are already treated differently by operand provenance, and unifying them needs the per-form modelling, not a wider gate. Durable owner: U6.VALUE_INFERENCE for the shallow pass's per-expression fallback (JSX / Super / MetaProperty / ImportExpression / ClassExpression), U6.ASYNC_GENERATOR + U6.CALL_RESOLVE for `await x`. Resolution gate: no later than the U6 lane close — the U6 lane may not close with this entry open. Acceptance tests (already in tree as executable parked canaries, un-ignored by the owning work): flow_return_coverage_tests::jsx_element_fragment_and_attribute_call_returns_are_not_any, ::class_expression_return_is_not_any, ::dynamic_import_expression_return_is_not_any, ::super_method_call_return_resolves_to_the_base_member, ::awaited_call_return_is_the_awaited_value_wrapped_again. Accepted cost until then: these rows publish a fabricated `any` warm. That `any` is NOT “under the checker’s answer” — `any` is bidirectionally assignable and silences checks in both directions — so the cost is a real wrong-answer class, bounded to these named forms.
